title: Kata Strandloom
tagline: Shape a strand. Find a style.
description: An original local-first 3D hair-grooming study with procedural strands, hands-on brushes and reversible layers on a simple mannequin.
features: Radius, strength, root lock and mirror controls
Validated JSON project backups and import
PNG viewport and OBJ polyline export
